attributes.label: Care Instructions
attributes.value: Keep tucked away in a dry place and avoid direct contact with perfumes and moisture

source.quotedPhrase: keeping it tucked away in a dry place after each use and avoiding direct contact with perfumes and moisture

sourceNotes.rawContent: Add a touch of feminine charm to your jewelry collection with our exquisite Gold Bow Necklace. This delicate ribbon-style pendant is a must-have fashion statement, designed to catch the light and complement any outfit. To ensure this trend-setting piece remains a staple in your wardrobe, we recommend keeping it tucked away in a dry place after each use and avoiding direct contact with perfumes and moisture to preserve its brilliant golden glow
